questions.ruling: A valid fixed provider is checked at acquisition, not an invented ongoing casting gate. Later removal or temporary use unavailability alone does not disable Flora. Retain its exact ability operand, current lawful PB/modifier and all actual nonspell/channel/action predicates.
Unused second creation closes immediately on any actual first-plant ending, not only its natural minute deadline. Already created second plant retains its independent deadline.
Current total level >=10 is tested at the additional Action within the still-open original use. Growth changes eligibility/capacity only; no automatic creation, healing, use refill or reopened claim.

Spend shared BA/offense at legal received command; resolve once in the original attached phase. Owner incapacity/death or subsequent channel loss alone does not retract it or terminate independent timed plants. Actual disabled/ended plants/illegal outcomes fail without refund. Existing armed entries need no new owner action; dead owner identity/round history persists.

verdantBond.basis: Its own acquisition is historical; its actual casting-route spell benefits and active-Flora state remain. No +1 to Flora DC because Flora is a nonspell body procedure. No free plants through the Verdant Bond alternative, no owner-death control transfer or new message operation.
